notes:
* [participant] While we did a great job getting feedback for the SIGs - I believe it surely got overwhelming for the Comms team and [participant] because there were too many to resolve at once.
IMO, we could divide it into multiple stages, starting with the SIG chairs & techleads, and then the Comms team, and finally the SIG Docs team.
   * [participant] Similar to how we structure feature blog reviews in stages, we can extend this to release announcements and mid-cycle blog.
   * [participant] 1-2 days between stages to give the author time to tackle the existing reviews first.
   * [participant] Comms starts the draft in a Google Doc, shares the doc with the chairs and tech leads before opening the GitHub PR for final review. ([participant] +1, [participant] +1)
   * [participant] Try this before documenting it as the “official” process. Need to find out if extra processes make things easier or harder. ([participant] +1)
